description: Unit tests for BridgeStateManagerImpl class, testing bridge state reading, caching, and notification handling.

methods.name: read_state_should_succeed_before_read
methods.description: Tests that the initial call to read_state retrieves the correct bridge interface names.

methods.name: read_state_should_succeed_after_read
methods.description: Verifies that bridge state is cached after the first read and subsequent reads do not invoke the external reader again.

methods.name: notify_state_changed_should_succeed
methods.description: Tests that the cache updates correctly when notify_state_changed is called for adding and removing interfaces.

methods.name: notify_state_changed_should_succeed_with_misplaced_add_event
methods.description: Ensures that a misplaced RTM_NEWLINK event (adding an interface that was already removed) is ignored.
